registered: 2026-11-07 15:30, before any fit -4 run on AddBiomechanics data
question: On real people, how close are the evalkit ground reaction forces (kinematics only, height contact, per-foot split) to force plates, on the scale of the published video pipeline (OpenCap, Uhlrich 2023, Table 1)?
use: descriptive anchor for the residual / contact / muscle criteria; no pass line

data.trials: develop_logs/test_runs/20261105_val_a/selection.json, every trial with a kin30 source (160: walk 24, run 24, sts 24, wholebody 24, stand 22, squat 22, jump 20)
data.input: kin30 motion.npz (18 AddB joint centres, 30 fps), as in val_a
data.mass: row mass_kg (AddB dynamics mass), as in val_a

pipeline: evalkit.fit (PREPARE evalkit-upright-flatfoot-torso95-limbreg-4) and evalkit.residual.evaluate with the registered contact margin; no static optimization
reference: per trial, leave-one-trial-out subject reference re-measured under fit -4 with the e_v2 floor-audit rules (frames with measured vertical GRF > 0.2 BW, valid, not excluded, both landmarks of that foot moving vertically slower than 0.1 m/s; tiers stand, then walk+sts+squat); subjects without either tier use the pooled other-subject median (reported as its own tier)
frames: evalkit.fit.scored frames whose measured GRF is valid and not excluded
measured_filter: measured GRF low-passed with the coordinate filter of the pipeline (4th-order Butterworth, 6 Hz, zero lag) before comparison, as OpenCap filtered both signals alike; unfiltered reported as sensitivity

metrics.G1: per-foot vertical GRF: MAE and RMSE in BW
metrics.G2: per-foot horizontal GRF: MAE of the horizontal error vector magnitude in BW (lab axes are not aligned with the walking direction, so no AP / ML split)
metrics.G3: total vertical GRF: MAE, RMSE in BW and Pearson r
metrics.G4: per-foot contact: balanced accuracy of the tool mask (heel or toe) against measured vertical GRF > 20 N
metrics.summary: per class median and IQR over trials; mean over classes

comparison.opencap_note: OpenCap does not state whether its GRF errors are per foot or summed; both are reported here. Its jump is a drop jump, ours is the AddB jump class. Its sit-to-stand GRF is measured with the seat; the evalkit models foot contact only, so sts per-foot errors include the seat load
comparison.val_a_kin30: develop_logs/test_runs/20261105_val_a/analysis.json variants.kin30 (old E pipeline, total GRF only)

conventions_not_derived: 0.2 BW loaded and 0.1 m/s flat thresholds of the reference (from e_v2)
